summary: This directory provides foundational utility functions and shared type definitions, including JSON schema structures and standardized result patterns, that serve as low-level infrastructure for the rest of the application.
responsibilities: Provide type-safe definitions for JSON structures
Implement standardized success and error result patterns
Support exhaustive type checking in conditional logic
Expose utilities for stack trace introspection and caller identification
Facilitate execution of public API operations with schema validation
relationships: The library uses result schemas to wrap operations, ensuring consistent public-facing error formats.
The JSON schema definitions rely on recursive structures to model complex data types accurately.
Exhaustive checking utilities allow developers to enforce complete handling of union types within the codebase.
Stack trace tools support debugging by providing context about the execution origin of specific operations.
designDecisions: Use of declarative schema definitions for runtime validation
Standardization of API responses through generic result structures
Strict type-level enforcement for exhaustive switch cases
Centralization of shared types and helpers to minimize code duplication
